sourcePolicy: Final integration records bind approved core, reference, slideshow, full-view and normalization artifacts to a runtime projection without changing mathematical meaning or mutating user-local state implicitly.
rules: All five approved artifact layers must be present and version-locked.
Runtime projection must satisfy the active E129 importer contract.
Merge mode must use lessonId and must not replace the complete content store.
The preferred 16 E129 roles must remain in order when a 16-slide runtime projection is used.
Automatic binding must not mutate localStorage or rewrite a monolithic content file without preserving all records.
Browser verification is required after explicit runtime import or durable merge.
Reader Pro, E235 and UI layout must remain unchanged during this integration pass.
